Constrained molecular dynamics is performed using the SHAKE{{cite|ryckaertt:jcp:1977}} algorithm.
In this algorithm, the Lagrangian for the system <math>\mathcal{L}</math> is extended as follows:
:<math>
\mathcal{L}^*(\mathbf{q,\dot{q}}) = \mathcal{L}(\mathbf{q,\dot{q}}) +
\sum_{i=1}^{r} \lambda_i \sigma_i(q),
</math>
where the summation is over ''r'' geometric constraints, <math>\mathcal{L}^*</math> is the Lagrangian for the extended system, and &lambda;<sub>''i''</sub> is a Lagrange multiplier associated with a geometric constraint &sigma;<sub>''i''</sub>:
:<math>
\sigma_i(q) = \xi_i({q})-\xi_i \;
</math>
with &xi;<sub>''i''</sub>(''q'') being a geometric parameter and &xi;<sub>''i''</sub> is the value of &xi;<sub>''i''</sub>(''q'') fixed during the simulation.

In the SHAKE algorithm, the Lagrange multipliers &lambda;<sub>i</sub> are determined in the iterative procedure:
#Perform a standard  MD step (leap-frog algorithm):
#:<math>
v^{t+{\Delta}t/2}_i = v^{t-{\Delta}t/2}_i + \frac{a^{t}_i}{m_i} {\Delta}t
</math>
#:<math>
q^{t+{\Delta}t}_i = q^{t}_i + v^{t+{\Delta}t/2}_i{\Delta}t
</math>
#Use the new positions ''q''(''t''+&Delta;''t'') to compute Lagrange multipliers for all constraints:
#:<math>
{\lambda}_k= \frac{1}{{\Delta}t^2} \frac{\sigma_k(q^{t+{\Delta}t})}{\sum_{i=1}^N m_i^{-1} \bigtriangledown_i{\sigma}_k(q^{t}) \bigtriangledown_i{\sigma}_k(q^{t+{\Delta}t})}
</math>
#Update the velocities and positions by adding a contribution due to restoring forces (proportional to &lambda;<sub>k</sub>):
#:<math>
v^{t+{\Delta}t/2}_i = v^{t-{\Delta}t/2}_i + \left( a^{t}_i-\sum_k \frac{{\lambda}_k}{m_i} \bigtriangledown_i{\sigma}_k(q^{t}) \right ) {\Delta}t
</math>
#:<math>
q^{t+{\Delta}t}_i = q^{t}_i + v^{t+{\Delta}t/2}_i{\Delta}t
</math>
#repeat steps 2-4 until either |&sigma;<sub>''i''</sub>(''q'')| are smaller than a predefined tolerance (determined by {{TAG|SHAKETOL}}), or the number of iterations exceeds {{TAG|SHAKEMAXITER}}.

=== Constrained molecular dynamics ===
For a description of constrained molecular dynamics see {{TAG|Constrained molecular dynamics}}.

* For a constrained molecular dynamics run with Andersen thermostat, one has to:
#Set the standard MD-related tags: {{TAG|IBRION}}=0, {{TAG|TEBEG}}, {{TAG|POTIM}}, and {{TAG|NSW}}
# Select the thermostat: 
## Set {{TAGDEF|MDALGO|1}}, and choose an appropriate setting for {{TAG|ANDERSEN_PROB}}.
## Set {{TAGDEF|MDALGO|2}}, and choose an appropriate setting for {{TAG|SMASS}}.
#Define geometric constraints in the {{FILE|ICONST}}-file, and set the STATUS parameter for the constrained coordinates to 0
#When the free-energy gradient is to be computed, set {{TAG|LBLUEOUT}}=.TRUE.
